name: etabs-mcp
description: Drive CSI ETABS (v22+) from Claude: model, load, analyse, design and inspect structures.
long_description: Agentic MCP server for CSI ETABS built on the official ETABS API. 70+ tools for modelling, lateral loads, analysis, steel/concrete/shear-wall design, code checks, offscreen renders, the interactive database, and signature-validated access to every ETABS API method. Requires Windows with ETABS 22 or newer installed and licensed.

connect_mode.title: Connect mode
connect_mode.description: auto = attach to a running ETABS or launch one; attach = only attach; start = always launch.

etabs_version.title: ETABS major version
etabs_version.description: e.g. 22 or 23. Leave empty for the running or newest installed version.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Refuse every call that changes the model.
